final: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 as region, SUM(t.amount) as total_amount, COUNT(*) as transaction_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(total_amount) as total_sum FROM account_totals) SELECT a.account_id, a.region, a.total_amount, a.transaction_count, CAST(a.total_amount AS REAL) / g.total_sum as fraction FROM account_totals a CROSS JOIN grand_total g ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
